adjudication.rationale: In `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts`, the email send is wrapped in a `try { await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests); } catch (err) { console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails"); }` block. This swallows the error (no rethrow / TRPCError), logs without including `err`, and the handler still returns `{ message: "Guests added" }`, so the client will treat the mutation as successful even if guest notification emails failed.
